verdict.rationale: Warp is a terminal emulator, so inline image display through a terminal graphics protocol (e.g. Kitty, iTerm2 or Sixel) is a fair axis. The evidence pack never mentions any such protocol or inline image rendering. Creating themes from a background image is an appearance feature, not a graphics protocol, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can display inline images and rich graphics via a documented terminal graphics protocol
